proof_text:
unfold isEven isEven_postcond
  have h_main : isEven_postcond (n) (isEven (n) h_precond) h_precond := by
    dsimp [isEven_postcond, isEven, isEven_precond]
    constructor
    · -- Prove (result → n % 2 = 0)
      intro h
      simp_all [Int.emod_eq_of_lt]
      <;> aesop
    · -- Prove (¬ result → n % 2 ≠ 0)
      intro h
      simp_all [Int.emod_eq_of_lt]
      <;> aesop
  exact h_main
